name: watch FSDI job 2
command:
while true; do curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8321/api/jobs | python3 -c "
import json,sys
js = {j['id']: j for j in json.load(sys.stdin)}
j3 = js.get(3,{})
st = j3.get('state','?')
print('job3:', st, (j3.get('error') or '')[:200])
exit(0 if st in ('done','error','cancelled') else 1)" && exit 0; sleep 60; done
description: watch FSDI shapes job 3 until terminal
